description: Tell Vitrine how an answer worked for your shopper, after you have used it. Pass the query_id of a search, trending, find_similar, complete_the_look or shop_the_look answer you received in the last 7 days, a rating ('useful' or 'not_useful'), and optionally liked_ids and disliked_ids (ids from that answer) and a one-sentence comment on what was missing. Liked pieces rise in trend scores for every agent; disliked ones fall. You can only rate answers sent to you; rating the same answer again replaces your rating. Never include personal data. Returns {query_id, rating, liked, disliked, comment_saved, message}.

anyOf.description: Optional self-identification. Identified callers help us rank better; keys make it reliable.

session_id.description: Your own opaque id linking calls in one shopping session. Never a user id.

comment.description: Optional: what was missing or wrong, in a sentence. No personal data.

disliked_ids.description: Ids from that answer that did not fit (optional).

liked_ids.description: Ids from that answer that fit well (optional).

query_id.description: The query_id of a search, trending, find_similar, complete_the_look or shop_the_look answer you received in the last 7 days.

rating.description: Did the results help your shopper? 'useful' or 'not_useful'.

name: rate_results
title: Rate an answer
